briefs.headline: World court: Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya

briefs.summary: Robotaxis suspended nationwide after California's freeway ban and incidents.

briefs.headline: Trump orders army to pause lead-azide blasts in Iowa
briefs.summary: Detonation programme halted after safety fears at the munitions plant.

briefs.headline: Alcaraz wins first ATP Finals title
briefs.summary: The Spaniard beats Zverev in the championship match in Turin.

briefs.headline: India v New Zealand Test ends in a draw
briefs.summary: Visitors fight back at Basin Reserve; India declared on 720 for 9.

briefs.headline: Modi opens AI centre at IIT Patna
briefs.summary: PM inaugurates the AI centre and a Rs 400 crore research park.

briefs.headline: Belgium strike cancels 429 Brussels flights
briefs.summary: National anti-austerity stoppage strands 59,000 passengers on Monday.

briefs.summary: Children among the dead as strikes hit the capital and Omdurman.

briefs.headline: Migrant boat capsizes off Senegal
briefs.summary: Dozens missing after a boat carrying migrants sinks off the coast.

briefs.summary: Tallinn closes the border from 1 December; Moscow cries 'Iron Curtain'.

briefs.summary: CEPA scraps tariffs on up to 98.5% of goods after a decade of talks.

briefs.headline: BepiColombo enters Mercury orbit
briefs.summary: European-Japanese probe begins mapping the innermost planet after 8 years.

lead.detail: Shares jump ~27% in a day, adding about $1 trillion in value. The board cites US government input: 'no national security risk'.
lead.headline: HUANG IS BACK
lead.sub: Nvidia board votes unanimously to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO — after Trump dialled into the board meeting

pinned.headline: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
pinned.summary: Board votes unanimously; Trump says he 'convinced' them. Shares soar ~27%.

pinned.headline: Ukraine sinks Russian warship off Libya
pinned.summary: Kyiv says seven naval drones sank the corvette Merkury at Benghazi; a second ship hit.

pinned.summary: Longest climate summit ever collapses in Antalya; draft had no fossil-fuel phase-down.

pinned.headline: NATO meets after missiles hit Poland
pinned.summary: Prosecutors confirm three Russian Kh-101 cruise missiles landed in south-east Poland.

pinned.summary: Champion Gukesh defends his title against Sindarov from today.

pinned.summary: FIFA hands the tournament to the United Kingdom; 'football's coming home'.
